documents.summary: WaterWorld Themed Waterpark Ayia Napa is a water park destination in Ayia Napa, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A large Greek-mythology-themed water park whose theming and ride range make it a destination rather than a routine resort pool complex.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.
